title: Core colors

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Name reproducible colors so different assets can share a stable visual vocabulary.
strategic_value: The five bright colors plus black and white can keep Instagram materials related across creators and formats.
demonstration: Five colored columns sit above two neutral rectangles, each labelled by name and hex value.
practical_value: Use the named swatches for color reference without interpreting their display areas as usage quotas.

content_islands.name: Chromatic swatches
content_islands.spec: Align Yellow, Orange, Pink, Lavender and Purple in equal columns across the top.

content_islands.name: Neutral swatches
content_islands.spec: Place White and Black in two broad lower fields and retain their labels.

reference_purposes.Expression: Five vivid swatches show the core palette’s character.
reference_purposes.Application: Names and hex labels make the color references reproducible.
